name: Senthor – Protect Against AI Crawlers
author: senthorio

sections.description:
Generative AIs (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Mistral, etc.) are scraping millions of articles every day, without authorization, control, or revenue for publishers.
Senthor for WordPress allows you to take back control:

  • Real-time detection of AI crawlers.
  • Selective blocking or authorization.
  • Monetization of each AI request as a new revenue stream.
  • Dashboard with detailed statistics.

This plugin connects your WordPress site to your Senthor account.
Once activated, your content is monitored and protected in the background without modifying your site.

External service

This plugin uses the Senthor API to provide protection against AI scraping.

What Data is Shared?
– IP address
– HTTP headers
– Request URI

Why is This Service Used?
This data is used solely for AI detection purposes and is not shared with any third parties.

Terms and Privacy Policy
For more details, review Senthor’s Terms & Privacy Policy.

Opt-Out or Disable
– By default, the API analysis is disabled.
– You can opt-in via the Senthor.io plugin settings.
– You can opt-out at any time by clicking “Revoke consent and disable API” in the plugin settings.

Why Senthor?

Senthor was created to address a simple fact: publishers and content creators are losing control in the AI era.
Every day, their articles are used to train or feed models without consent or compensation.

With Senthor, you finally decide who can access your content and you turn this traffic into a new revenue stream.

Our mission: to ensure that publishers are protected and paid when AI uses their work.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Senthor.io and create a free account.
  4. Add your domain (e.g. www.yoursite.com) in your Senthor dashboard.
  5. Check the “WordPress site” option for that domain.
  6. Stats and protections will start working immediately.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Senthor.io account?

Yes. The plugin acts as a connector between your site and Senthor.io. An account is required to activate detection and view your data.

Does this block Google or regular search engines?

No. By default, Senthor allows legitimate crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, etc.). You keep full control over which bots are allowed or blocked.

Is it free?

You can test Senthor with a free trial account. Paid plans unlock monetization and advanced features.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The plugin works in the background and does not add visible latency for your visitors.
